text: Replica health, job outcomes, and the AG-membership check already exist in this environment -- they just live inside tools only a DBA opens. This video puts them in front of the whole team.
Three signals matter most: replica synchronization health, backup and maintenance job outcomes on both nodes, and the recurring check comparing every database against BrennanAG's actual membership.
ProductionSchedulingDB's own history -- flagged, then fixed -- is the first thing pinned to the new report, so that exact gap is now something anyone can see, not just something a script once caught.
A Power BI report, connected through BrennanAGListener in Import mode, refreshes every 15 minutes across three pages: replica health, job status, and the membership gap check.
The DBA team can now check system health without opening SSMS. Next: taking all of this into the room with leadership.
